jobs.title: Europe Product Manager
jobs.description:
MEDLINE est un groupe international, fabricant et distributeur mondial de dispositifs médicaux et chirurgicaux pour les établissements de santé. Notre entreprise connaît depuis plus de 10 ans une croissance constante en Europe et notre ambition est de continuer sur cette belle lancée. Pour développer notre gamme de produit Dynacor, nous recherchons un(e) :

Chef de produit junior Europe (H/F)

En occupant ce poste, vous serez responsable de la croissance des ventes et de la rentabilité de votre gamme de produits. Vous collaborez avec différents services Medline notamment le service commercial, le marketing, la qualité, la Supply Chain et la finance. Ce qui rend la gestion de produits unique chez Medline, c’est votre capacité à gérer vos gammes de produits comme s’il s’agissait de votre propre entreprise.

Comment pouvez-vous nous aider ?

- Piloter et développer un portefeuille de produits (Sets de soin, pensements pour cathéter, etc) afin d’optimiser la rentabilité et d’atteindre les objectifs marketing, financiers et de croissance de l’entreprise.
- Superviser et accompagner les équipes support pour garantir la performance de la division.
- Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes de production pour assurer le suivi des niveaux de service, des prévisions et des processus, dans une logique d’amélioration continue et de satisfaction client .
- Définir et coordonner les actions de communication marketing de la division en proposant des outils et plans innovants visant à renforcer sa visibilité et sa notoriété.
- Négocier avec les fournisseurs en partenariat avec le service achats afin d’ optimiser les coûts des matières premières et d’ améliorer la performance économique de l’activité.
- Identifier et développer de nouvelles sources d’approvisionnement pour enrichir et renforcer le portefeuille produits.
- Réaliser une veille stratégique et concurrentielle en analysant les marchés, les tendances, les besoins clients, les prix et les parts de marché.
- Assurer une présence régulière sur le terrain pour former les clients, accompagner le développement de nouveaux comptes et apporter un support aux clients existants.

Nous avons tout prévu :

- Pour assurer un bon équilibre entre votre vie privée et professionnelle, vous pourrez effectuer du télétravail jusqu’à 3 jours par semaine après une formation sur site.

- Medline Châteaubriant n’est situé qu’à 1h00 de Nantes, Rennes et Angers, mais pour faciliter vos déplacements, nous avons développé un partenariat avec une application de covoiturage .

- Si vous roulez en électrique, des bornes de recharge sont disponibles sur le site à tarif préférentiel.

- Une rémunération juste vous sera proposée et à celle-ci s’ajoutera un bonus annuel sur objectif, des tickets restaurant d’une valeur de 9,00 € par jour travaillé (60% à la charge de l’employeur), de l’intéressement, de nombreux avantages CSE et pleins d’autres surprises.

- Pour assurer le bien-être de nos salariés et garantir la convivialité sur le site, une salle de pause aménagée est à disposition avec des fruits et du café gratuit.

Pour découvrir un environnement international, multiculturel, bénéficiant d’un réel savoir-faire industriel, Rejoignez-nous !

Comment nous rencontrer ?
- Si ce poste vous intéresse, envoyez-nous votre candidature.

- Notre Responsable du recrutement reprendra contact avec vous téléphoniquement si votre profil correspond à notre besoin.

- Les candidats présélectionnés auront un entretien sur site ou en visio avec son/sa futur(e) Manager et la Responsable du recrutement

- Pour terminer le processus, vous rencontrerez votre futur N+2 en entretien ainsi que la Responsable RH. Une visite de site sera systématiquement organisée dans le processus.

A PROPOS DE MEDLINE :
Fondée en 1910 aux Etats-Unis, Medline est une entreprise familiale, mondiale spécialisée dans les soins de santé qui fabrique et distribue des dispositifs médicaux de haute qualité. Soutenus par plus de 36 000 employés dans le monde, nous sommes fiers d’améliorer les soins de santé partout et chaque jour pour répondre aux besoins de nos clients. Medline International a été fondée en Europe en 2011, et depuis, notre croissance ne cesse de s’accroître . Que vous soyez, Chef de produit, Spécialiste Supply Chain, Responsable commercial, ou Contrôleur de gestion, nous récompensons l’engagement, le travail, les résultats et la réussite de nos employés. Nous sommes passionnés par l’accomplissement de notre mission : fournir des produits médicaux de qualité et à forte valeur ajoutée pour améliorer les soins et la qualité de vie de nos patients. Souhaitez-vous nous accompagner dans cette mission ?

Medline s’engage à réduire son empreinte carbone, à développer des produits responsables, à soutenir ses employés et la population locale, et à promouvoir des normes éthiques en interne et parmi ses partenaires fournisseurs. Cliquez ici pour découvrir ce que Medline fait pour rendre les soins de santé plus durables pour les personnes et la planète.

Nous avons à cœur de d’accompagner la carrière de nos collaborateurs. Chez MEDLINE, nous favorisons et encourageons la mobilité interne ainsi que le développement des compétences . Nous sommes présents dans plusieurs pays en Europe et dans le monde, si vous souhaitez évoluer au sein d’une autre culture, nous pourrons vous accompagner dans votre mobilité internationale .

jobs.title: MBA Intern, Product Management - Summer 2027
jobs.description:
Job Summary
With over 50 years of consecutive growth, Medline has more than 43,000 employees worldwide and business in over 125 countries. Recently named one of the nation’s "Best and Brightest Companies to Work For,” we have a state-of-the-art headquarters in Northfield, IL, and a dynamic city office at the Merchandise Mart in downtown Chicago. We are proud to offer opportunities for those who are curious, collaborative, and ready to make an impact.

The healthcare landscape is evolving rapidly, and our customers rely on us for solutions backed by smart, data-driven thinking. Medline’s MBA Internship Program offers MBA students a unique opportunity to contribute meaningfully while developing the analytical and leadership skills needed to grow their careers in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

This 12-week summer internship is designed to immerse professionals within our Product Management organization, tasked with analyzing data, identifying trends, and making recommendations that influence key business decisions. Interns will gain exposure to senior leaders, participate in professional development sessions, and build lasting connections through curated networking opportunities.
Job Description
Internship Responsibilities:
Intern responsibilities will vary based on functional placement, but typical responsibilities include:
- Translate customer, market, product, and business insights into clear, actionable recommendations

- Deliver a meaningful project that influences product strategy, portfolio decisions, commercialization, or business performance

- Develop and present actionable recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders

- Support strategic initiatives, process improvements, or cost-savings efforts

- Collaborate with teams across Sales, Operations, Product Management, Finance, and more to solve real business problems

- Prepare leadership-ready presentations or reports to share findings

Qualifications:
- Currently pursuing an MBA degree

- 3+ years of professional business experience in a relevant field

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; comfort working with data

- Ability to establish and maintain relationships with individuals at all levels of the organization, in the business community & with vendors along with preferred negotiation experience

- Demonstrated ability to present to senior management with the purpose of influencing decisions

Medline Industries, LP, and its subsidiaries, offer a competitive total rewards package, continuing education & training, and tremendous potential with a growing worldwide organization.

The anticipated salary range for this position:
$92,000.00 - $138,000.00 Annual
The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s location, education, experience, skills, and abilities. Medline will not pay less than the applicable minimum wage or salary threshold.

Our benefit package includes 401(k) contributions, paid time off, as well as access to the Employee Assistance Program, Employee Resource Groups and the Employee Service Corp for interns and temporary roles.

We’re dedicated to creating a Medline where everyone feels they belong and can grow their career. We strive to do this by seeking diversity in all forms, acting inclusively, and ensuring that people have tools and resources to perform at their best. Explore our Belonging page  here .

Medline Industries, LP is an equal opportunity employer. Medline evaluates qualified individuals without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, neurodivergence, protected veteran status, marital or family status, caregiver responsibilities, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Cardiac Portfolio
jobs.description:
Medline - Together, Advancing Healthcare
Medline is a healthcare company–a manufacturer, distributor and so much more, doing business in more than 125 countries and territories around the world. We provide the quality medical products and solutions our customers need to deliver their best care to every person in every care setting.
Medline is committed to reducing our carbon footprint, developing responsible products, supporting our employees and local communities, and promoting high ethical standards internally and among our supplier partners. Click here to discover what Medline is doing to make healthcare more sustainable for people and the planet.

Job Summary
We are seeking a commercially minded Product Manager to lead the strategic management of our Cardiac and Interventional portfolio, including Cath Lab consumables, procedure packs and related solutions.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys combining strategic thinking, clinical understanding and commercial acumen to grow a portfolio that delivers real value to customers and patients.
Job Description
About the Role
As Product Manager, you will take ownership of the ANZ Cardiac and Interventional portfolio, with a strong focus on downstream execution and delivering commercial growth outcomes.
This is not a traditional desk-based product management role. We're looking for someone who can take a growth mindset and turn opportunities into results. You'll spend your time working closely with customers, clinicians, sales teams and key stakeholders to drive product adoption, execute successful trials, deliver education programs and identify opportunities to expand the portfolio. If you enjoy translating strategy into action and making a measurable impact on business performance, this could be the role for you.

Key Responsibilities
- Develop and execute portfolio strategies that support sustainable sales growth and profitability.
- Identify market trends, competitor activity and customer needs to inform business decisions.
- Execute new product introductions, product launches and marketing campaigns.
- Manage product lifecycle activities, including portfolio optimisation and SKU rationalisation.
- Build strong relationships with key customers, KOLs, distributors and industry stakeholders.
- Deliver product education, clinical training and support programs for internal and external customers.
- Partner with Sales teams to provide product, pricing and market insights.
- Drive cost reduction and operational improvement initiatives across the portfolio.

About You

- Previous experience as an Associate Product Manager or Product Manager
- Demonstrated experience within the cardiac medical device, cardiac consumables, procedure pack, or cath lab environment.
- Demonstrated experience managing the full product lifecycle, including product launches, portfolio optimisation, and product discontinuations.
- Strong market analysis and competitor intelligence experience, with the ability to translate insights into commercial action.
- Experience developing product positioning, value propositions, and customer-facing marketing materials.

#LI-AUS
What we will offer you
• Hybrid working environment - 3 days in the office and 2 days from home
• Learning culture with dedicated in-house training and study assistance
• Enjoy 1 day of birthday leave and volunteer leave per year
• Purchase additional annual leave scheme
• Private health care discount with BUPA
• Free Partnership with Sonder - a leader in medical, mental health and safety employee assistance 24 hours a day 7 days a week
• Novated leasing
• Free EV charging bays for employees
• Discounted gym membership
and much more!

Belonging at Medline
It takes every team member for us to succeed. At Medline you can expect to feel respected, enjoy your work, reach your potential, and be given the opportunity to do more - and go further. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome your unique contribution regardless of your culture, ethnicity, life stage, race, gender identity, disability, or religious beliefs.

jobs.title: Regional Product Manager
jobs.description:
Medline - Together, Advancing Healthcare
Medline is a healthcare company–a manufacturer, distributor and so much more, doing business in more than 125 countries and territories around the world. We provide the quality medical products and solutions our customers need to deliver their best care to every person in every care setting.
Medline is committed to reducing our carbon footprint, developing responsible products, supporting our employees and local communities, and promoting high ethical standards internally and among our supplier partners. Click here to discover what Medline is doing to make healthcare more sustainable for people and the planet.
Job Summary
The Regional Product Manager – Operating Room & Peri-Operative Solutions is responsible for driving the regional product management agenda and leading the strategic management of a portfolio of products and solutions supporting the Operating Room (OR) and peri-operative care environment across Southeast Asia.
The role focuses on identifying market opportunities, generating actionable insights, and translating them into effective portfolio and go-to-market strategies that enhance customer value and support sustainable business growth. The incumbent will develop a deep understanding of surgical workflows, patient pathways, customer needs, market dynamics, and competitive landscapes to ensure the portfolio remains relevant and differentiated across diverse healthcare systems.
Acting as a critical link between Global Product Divisions, regional teams, distributors, and in-market stakeholders, the incumbent will drive product readiness, launch excellence, portfolio optimisation, and commercial execution across Southeast Asia.
Success in this role requires strong strategic thinking, commercial acumen, stakeholder influence, and the ability to operate effectively in a matrix organisation. The individual will build strong partnerships across functions and markets, support capability development within the commercial organisation, and contribute to Medline’s long-term growth strategy within the Operating Room & Peri-Operative Solutions portfolio.
Job Description
Responsibilities:
- Identify and develop new products and manage each stage of the process through take to market.

- Develop and implement comprehensive marketing plans and promotional programs for existing products to include product strategy development, pricing strategy, collateral creation and brand management.

- Review monthly financial performance and determine contributing factors. Offer solutions for detrimental sales or cost trends. Prepare product forecasts to include revenue and expense expectations. Analyze sales trends over time and impact of competitive strategies. Support forecasts and budgets with appropriately detailed marketing plans.

- Work with Manufacturing, Purchasing and Engineering to reduce Cost of Goods by assessing packaging, alternate materials, new sources of material, stocking, make to order, direct to customer shipments, etc. Manage inventory by focusing on eliminating surplus and optimizing SKU count. May negotiate pricing with vendors for raw materials and finished goods. Visit vendors to develop products and train personnel all aspects of each product and usages. Coordinate materials with vendors and develop finished custom items.

- Analyze and bid on GPO and/or Integrated Delivery Network contracts for assigned product categories.

- Develop and deliver training materials for internal stakeholders, sales forces and customers. Create sales tools.

- Conduct market research and translate that research into new products, product improvements, or line extensions by providing leadership to a multi-functional team.

- Travel with sales force to support efforts to convert customers to purchase Medline products. Provide timely follow up to sales forces by answering product questions via e-mail and phone.

Skills & Experience
- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Life Sciences, or a related field, with advanced degrees being advantageous.
- Minimum 5 years of experience in product management, marketing, or commercial roles within the healthcare, medical device, or life sciences industry.
- Experience supporting products used within the Operating Room and peri-operative care environment, with a strong understanding of surgical workflows, clinical practices, customer needs, and healthcare purchasing dynamics.
- Demonstrated ability in strategic thinking, business analysis, and translating insights into actionable growth plans.
- Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence and collaborate across cross-functional and multicultural teams.
- Experience working with distributors and managing indirect markets within Southeast Asia is highly desirable.
- Strong communication, presentation, and storytelling skills to engage both internal and external stakeholders effectively.
- Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
- Self-driven, proactive, and capable of managing responsibilities independently with a strong sense of ownership.
- Strong analytical skills with proficiency in data interpretation and tools such as Excel, PowerPoint, and other business intelligence platforms.
- Willingness and flexibility to travel frequently across Southeast Asia as required.
- Proficiency in additional regional languages such as Mandarin, Bahasa or Thai is considered a strong advantage to communicate with in country distributors.

What we will offer you
• Hybrid working environment
• Comprehensive Health Benefits including access to dedicated Employee Assistant Program
• Learning & Development opportunities in a diverse and inclusive workplace
and much more!

Belonging at Medline
It takes every team member for us to succeed. At Medline you can expect to feel respected, enjoy your work, reach your potential, and be given the opportunity to do more - and go further. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome your unique contribution regardless of your culture, ethnicity, life stage, race, gender identity, disability, or religious beliefs.

jobs.title: Product Management Intern - Summer 2027
jobs.description:
Job Summary
With more than 50 years of consecutive growth, we’ve built a dynamic workplace where over 45,000 employees worldwide are empowered to grow and contribute to our entrepreneurial culture.

As we continue to grow, we’re looking for talented individuals, like you, to join our team. Our people are genuine, creative, and proactive problem-solvers who move fast, move mountains, and succeed together.

A Medline internship provides real-world, hands-on experience where you can make a true impact. Interns take ownership of projects while gaining valuable insight into the day-to-day responsibilities of their roles. Beyond the work itself, the summer experience includes enriching opportunities such as social and networking events, leadership presentations, community service activities, and more. Through meaningful work and professional development experiences, you’ll build a tangible skillset that helps set you apart from your peers.

Our internships span a variety of business areas and are open to rising seniors in undergraduate programs. Designed to support both personal and professional growth, the 10-week summer program runs from early June through mid-August in one of our four corporate offices in the Chicagoland area.
Job Description
A Product Management Intern at Medline will work closely with the Product Division team members and will be exposed to all areas of the business, including product development, marketing, global sourcing, sales, negotiation, quality assurance, operations, and financial strategies.

Possible projects   could include:

- Development and launch of new product lines and/or product improvements

- Assisting   in the development and execution of sales and marketing strategies

- Collaborating with marketing to develop promotional pieces and design packaging

- Researching the market and performing analyses to   determine   new opportunities to grow the business

- Crafting and delivering presentations to our sales force and customers

- Negotiating with vendors to ensure business goals are met while   maintaining   strong business relationships

- Working with Inventory Management to ensure proper stock levels and service level goals are met

Qualifications:

- Junior standing   required

- 3.0   minimum   GPA preferred

- Previous   internship experience in product management/development, marketing, and/or business preferred

- Active interest in the Healthcare industry preferred

- Excellent organizational, planning, communication and follow-up skills   required

- Excellent presentation skills for large and small groups

- Must have strategic,   analytical   and problem-solving skills

- Must have a bias toward action and be results oriented

- Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite including Excel,   PowerPoint   and Outlook

- Unrestricted permanent US work authorization

jobs.title: Director, Product Master Data
jobs.description:
Job Summary
Join Medline and help shape the future of healthcare through data, innovation, and technology. As Director, Product Master Data Management, you will play a critical role in advancing Medline's enterprise data strategy by helping build a trusted product data foundation that supports growth, enhances customer experiences, strengthens regulatory compliance, and enables the next generation of automation and AI capabilities. This is a unique opportunity to influence enterprise-wide transformation at a market-leading healthcare company known for its entrepreneurial spirit, customer focus, and commitment to improving healthcare.

Working closely with senior business and technology leaders, you will drive strategic initiatives that elevate data governance, quality, and business value across the organization. The ideal candidate is a collaborative and forward-thinking leader who thrives in complex environments, excels at influencing cross-functional teams, and is passionate about turning data into a competitive advantage.
Job Description
Job Responsibilities:
- Lead Medline’s master data strategy and operating model, anchored by product master data. Establish a centralized Master Data Center of Excellence to govern policies, taxonomy, critical data elements, workflows, controls, and platform design, while fostering enterprise-wide data ownership and partnering with business and IS leaders to prioritize initiatives and deliver business value.

- Lead organizational change by shifting capacity from manual execution to governance, stewardship, taxonomy, and automation, while establishing clear ownership boundaries and a workload-based operating model.

- Work cross functionally to define and measure KPIs of the program in business terms, not only data metrics, tracking speed to revenue, search and conversion performance, complaint and return reduction, regulatory completeness, duplicate rate, downstream rejection rate and issue resolution time, and report data quality performance to senior leadership on a fixed cadence.

- Drive the automation and AI agenda for master data, advancing intelligent data acquisition, classification, enrichment, and governance while championing industry-leading practices and cross-functional alignment.

- Define and govern the enterprise product record and taxonomy standards, ensuring consistent product data, classification, and regulatory compliance across SAP, Informatica, and downstream platforms.

- Lead enterprise data governance and quality management through defined standards, ownership, controls, monitoring, and continuous remediation across core data platforms.

- Act as a key thought leader in defining Medline's overall data roadmap and data strategy, and determine how data assets are best leveraged in support of enterprise strategy.

Management responsibilities include:
- Strategic, tactical and operational planning (12 + months) for the function or department

- Direct budgetary responsibility for one or more departments, functions or major projects/programs

- Interpret and execute policies for departments/projects and develops

- Recommend and implement new policies or modifications to existing policies

- Hiring staff, recommending pay increases, performing performance reviews, training and development of staff, estimating personnel needs, assigning work, meeting completion dates, interpreting and ensuring consistent application of organizational policies.

Minimum Job Requirements:

Education:
- Bachelor’s degree.

Work Experience:
- At least 7 years of data management experience in a technology, business management and/or consulting role.

- At least 2 years of experience managing people, including hiring, developing, motivating and directing people as they work.

Additional:

- Experience applying advanced knowledge of data manipulation and reporting tools.

- Experience diagnosing, isolating, and resolving complex issues and recommending and implementing strategies to resolve problems.

- Experience working with cross-functional teams and facilitating teams to identify and implement solutions to complex problems.

- Experience with project management.

- Experience with SAP and Informatica.

Medline Industries, LP, and its subsidiaries, offer a competitive total rewards package, continuing education & training, and tremendous potential with a growing worldwide organization.

The anticipated salary range for this position:
$154,000.00 - $231,000.00 Annual
The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s location, education, experience, skills, and abilities. This role is bonus and/or incentive eligible. Medline will not pay less than the applicable minimum wage or salary threshold.

Our benefit package includes health insurance, life and disability, 401(k) contributions, paid time off, etc., for employees working 30 or more hours per week on average. For roles where employees work less than 30 hours per week, benefits include 401(k) contributions, paid time off, as well as access to the Employee Assistance Program, Employee Resource Groups and the Employee Service Corp.
